age.evidence: adult (~11 weeks old) C57BL/6J male mice

sex.evidence: adult (~11 weeks old) C57BL/6J male mice

dosing.evidence: Whether administered PSIL or PME, mice received psilocybin at a dose of 4.4 mg/kg intraperitoneally (i.p.). PSIL and PME were dissolved in 0.9% NaCl.

dosing.doses_raw: PME adjusted to a PSIL dose of 4.4 mg/kg (≈10.15 mg PME per 30 g mouse)
dosing.evidence: Since 1 mg of psilocybin is found in 76.92 mg of PME (1.3%)... 10.15 mg of PME is needed per 30 g mouse.

handling.evidence: Paper does not mention handling beyond injection.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed under standardized conditions... randomly extracting them from the holding cages

enrichment_housing.evidence: Paper describes standardized housing but does not mention enrichment.

assays.assay_description: HTR measured over 20 min in a magnetometer apparatus immediately after i.p. injection; small neodymium magnets attached to mouse ears, signal recorded at 1000 Hz; total HTR, peak HTR, and 2-min time-bin time course analyzed. Both PSIL and PME compared to vehicle at psilocybin dose of 4.4 mg/kg.

application_type.evidence: mice received psilocybin at a dose of 4.4 mg/kg intraperitoneally (i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: the ear-tagged animals were placed inside a magnetometer apparatus... immediately after injection

setup_restrain.evidence: animals were placed inside a magnetometer apparatus (freely moving, no restraint described)

food_restriction.evidence: Magnetometer apparatus has no food; home cage had free access to food (test conducted in separate apparatus).

water_restriction.evidence: Magnetometer apparatus has no water; home cage had free access to water.

time_to_assay.evidence: placed inside a magnetometer apparatus immediately after injection of vehicle, PSIL, or PME

outcomes.summary: Both PSIL and PME (at psilocybin 4.4 mg/kg i.p.) significantly increased total and peak HTR compared to vehicle over 20 min, with HTR peaking ~4 min post-injection. No significant difference between PSIL and PME was observed.
outcomes.statistics: Time × Treatment F[18,333]=10.86 p<0.0001, Treatment F[2,37]=52.18 p<0.0001; PSIL vs PME: Time × Treatment F[9,252]=1.162 p=0.3197, Treatment F[1,28]=0.04689 p=0.8301; Total HTR Vehicle vs PSIL/PME p<0.0001, PSIL vs PME p=0.9419; Peak HTR Vehicle vs PSIL/PME p<0.0001, PSIL vs PME p=0.8662
outcomes.evidence: HTR over time (2 min time bins over 20 min) showed a strong increase of HTR... compared to vehicle... no difference was observed between PSIL and PME

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total and peak PSIL/PME-induced HTR during the 20 min measuring period were compiled (Fig. 1b, c) plus time course (Fig. 1a).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR over time (2 min time bins over 20 min) showed a strong increase of HTR

B4_ethological.evidence: Head twitch response is excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: HTR is non-social; animals tested alone.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: A custom MATLAB script was used to record the processed signal... presented as graphs showing the change in current as peaks — signal thresholding, not behavioural classification.

B8_multivariate.evidence: No PCA/multivariate analysis of HTR measures reported.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding described in magnetometer apparatus.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in testing apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in magnetometer apparatus.

E7_social_context.evidence: Single animal placed in magnetometer apparatus after injection.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in the magnetometer apparatus during the 20 min recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR was measured over 20 min in a single session immediately after injection.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Head twitch response (HTR) was measured over 20 min

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug HTR baseline recording reported.

D5_followup.evidence: HTR measured only acutely; no >=24 h follow-up HTR recording.

D6_circadian.evidence: Session was 20 min, well under 6 h.

judge_notes: Only the Head Twitch Response qualifies as a behavioural assay; western blot synaptic protein measurements, plasma psilocin HPLC, and CE-FTMS metabolomics are molecular/biochemical readouts and were excluded per rubric.
B1 scored 1 (2-3 measures: total HTR, peak HTR, time-course bins) — Qwen's score of 1 preferred over GLM's 2 since 2-3 measures = 1 point per rubric.
Both candidates agreed on most items; consolidated to high confidence where the paper explicitly supports the value (e.g., setup_restrain = no since animals were freely placed in the magnetometer).
Created separate dosing entries for chemical psilocybin (PSIL) and psilocybin mushroom extract (PME) since they are distinct compounds, though dosed at the same psilocybin-equivalent concentration.
